query:
SELECT pi.periodoCustoId, pc.mes, pc.ano, pi.producaoTotal 
FROM planilha_importada pi 
INNER JOIN periodo_custo pc ON pi.periodoCustoId = pc.id 
ORDER BY pc.ano, pc.mes;
